summary: Build ESG skills in materiality, emissions data, due diligence, and reporting. Explore the five-day foundation course and practical curriculum.
lede: ESG training helps sustainability, risk, and reporting professionals assess material issues and organize evidence for decisions and disclosures. Participants map impacts and stakeholders, build a basic emissions inventory using the GHG Protocol, review data quality and controls, and prepare disclosure evidence for GRI Standards and IFRS S1 and S2, along with a prioritized action plan.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level ESG course is designed for professionals who collect, review, govern, or report environmental, social, and governance information across organizational functions.
modules: UN Guiding Principles and Due Diligence
OECD Guidelines and ESG Value Chains
GRI Reporting and ESG Action Plans
prerequisites: No coding or specialist ESG reporting experience is required. Familiarity with organizational operations or reporting is useful; bring a laptop with access to Microsoft Excel or compatible spreadsheet software for the dashboard exercise.
